items.title: Alibaba shipped Qwen3.8-Max for autonomous coding
items.oneliner: Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max pushes unsupervised coding into production territory, signaling that agent reliability is becoming the real model battleground.

items.title: Google moved Gemini deeper into Chrome
items.oneliner: Gemini Spark now handles logged-in errands inside Chrome, tightening Google's grip on workflows that used to belong to the open web.

items.title: Dreamina extended controllable video generation
items.oneliner: Dreamina now generates controllable videos up to three minutes with timestamp edits and 50 references, raising the floor for AI video tooling.

items.title: Fake SQLite CVEs fooled major databases
items.oneliner: Hallucinated SQLite vulnerabilities reached NVD and CISA, proving AI-generated security sludge can now poison the vulnerability supply chain.

items.title: Google used AI to harden Chrome
items.oneliner: Google says AI security agents helped fix 1,000-plus Chrome bugs, including a 13-year-old sandbox escape humans missed.

items.title: A local pentesting agent fits on phones
items.oneliner: Nightcrawler runs a local AI pentesting agent on a smartphone, making autonomous recon and reporting cheaper, quieter, and harder to spot.

items.title: UNAM voided thousands of AI-tainted exams
items.oneliner: UNAM canceled about 3,000 online exam scores over suspected AI cheating, showing education fraud detection is now an operational problem.

items.title: Reddit's scraping case against Perplexity survived
items.oneliner: Perplexity failed to dismiss Reddit's scraping lawsuit, a reminder that training-data risk is shifting from debate to courtroom exposure.

items.title: AirLLM squeezed 70B onto 4GB GPUs
items.oneliner: AirLLM claims 70B inference on a single 4GB GPU without quantization, which could reshape edge deployment economics if it holds up.

items.title: Rust proposed immobile types and guaranteed destructors
items.oneliner: Rust's new Move and Forget traits target self-referential and async pain points, bringing stricter lifetime guarantees to real systems code.
